'''Jorli''' was a junior aide on [[Parco Ein]]'s staff who contacted [[Daven Quarle]] to seek his advice on a few groups who would not leave the [[Verkuylian Imperial Governor's Hall]] after a party held by Ein. It is unknown if Jorli left with the other [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] when offered to after the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberated [[Verkuyl]] or if he stayed or defected to the New Republic.
